policy.title: Sample HR Leave Policy
policy.summary: All leave requests must be submitted through the HR portal . Unused casual leave cannot be carried forward to the next calendar year . Emergency sick leave should be reported to the manager as soon as possible . Contact the HR department if a leave balance appears incorrect or if a request remains pending beyond the expected processing time .

sentiment_analysis.text: Raj was very happy with the HR team's quick response to his leave request.
Priya is frustrated because her sick leave request has been pending for two weeks.
The HR support team at Ideas2IT was helpful, but the approval process was slow.
